evidence.any: A building with a seniors community house

calculation_handling.description: A building with a seniors community house must have been built more than 5 years before use as one, excluding additions or exterior alterations.
calculation_handling.gaps: Construction dates of existing buildings are not held.

units.disclosure: The requirement that the building be more than 5 years old before use as a seniors community house is not evaluated.

150.30.40.1(1).explanation: A building used as a seniors community house must have been built more than 5 years earlier, not counting additions or exterior alterations.
